p3_b0.ocr: In Fiscal Year 2024, Lockheed Martin's supply chain analysis reveals critical metrics across various materials: MaterialA has a lead time of 30 days with a cost of CNY150,000 for materials, CNY50,000 for labor, and transportation costs not specified; MaterialB has a lead time of 45 days with a material cost of CNY200,000, labor at CNY60,000, and unspecified transportation; MaterialC has a lead time of 60 days, incurring CNY250,000 for materials, CNY75,000 for labor, and unspecified transportation; MaterialD shows a lead time of 30 days with costs of CNY100,000 for materials, CNY40,000 for labor, and unspecified transportation; MaterialE has a lead time of 50 days with a material cost of CNY300,000, labor at CNY90,000, and unspecified transportation.
